Commissioned by Cool Alvin. Thank you for the support!

The RAW files for this doujin are in rather low quality, but they seem to be the highest available quality available online. They are the same quality as the ones found on the artist's support sites. Please consider supporting them here:

https://kanemasita.fanbox.cc/posts/8812280
https://fantia.jp/posts/3087616

Other versions:
Japanese (RAW, Digital): https://e-hentai.org/g/3133000/655fd6a863/
Chinese (Translated, Digital): https://e-hentai.org/g/3296482/dc97cf7624/

The images in the Chinese translation appear to have a slightly higher pixel count, but according to the description, that is because the translator used an AI tool to scale up the images.
